brief: Blue Social, an independent supporters' group (not affiliated with any club), launches free big-screen match nights and a five-a-side tournament for fans of Chelsea and the Premier League in London, eight weeks from now. All ages. The goal is to win new young members across London. $20,000 budget.

e.note: Reading results for A1, A2

critique.summary: A1 is clearly strongest: 20.1% reach (10th percentile 18.9%) at $934 per point, more than double the benchmark's 8.1% at $1891 per point, driven by targeted city social plus two early podcast ads that lift word of mouth to 56.5%. Late pop-ups ($2500 each on days 53–54) and the $300 café partners each earn only 0.3–0.5% of adoption, and A2's lack of podcasts leaves it at 14.9% reach and $1150 per point.

findings.finding: Reaches 20.1% (18.9%–21.3%) at $934 per point; the Talk Is Jericho (6.3%, $3450) and Monday Morning Podcast (5.7%, $3500) ads earn far more per dollar than the day-53 Moca caffee pop-up (0.4%, $2500).

Reaches 14.9% (14.3%–15.5%) at $1150 per point; social carries 33.0% of adoption while the Osterley (0.5%) and Luso Flavours (0.3%) pop-ups at $2500 each, run on days 53–54, are too late for word of mouth.
Reaches 8.1% at $1891 per point with only 42.8% word of mouth, so taste-targeted media in both plans more than doubles efficiency.

changes.change: In A1, drop the day-53 popup at Moca caffee (951B27AF) and put the $2500 into a third host-read podcast ad, or repeat Talk Is Jericho, around days 20–25.
changes.why: Podcast ads earn about 6% of adoption each, versus 0.4% for the late pop-up.

changes.change: Extend A1's social:city run from 45 to 55 days, using the $1250 of unspent budget.
changes.why: Targeted social is the top-credited action in both plans, and A2 ran it for 55 days.

changes.change: If keeping any pop-up, move it to around day 30 in Greenwich (zone 2, mean fit 0.805, 2.3% of the audience, the largest hot zone) instead of days 53–54.
changes.why: Pop-ups seeded in the final days leave no time for word of mouth to spread.

changes.change: Cut the weakest $300 partners (Munchy's in Hounslow, Luso Flavours in Bexley) unless the pop-up moves next to them.
changes.why: Each earns only 0.3–0.4% of adoption on its own.

e.note: A1 is clearly strongest: 20.1% reach (10th percentile 18.9%) at $934 per point, more than double the benchmark's 8.1% at $1891 per point, driven by targeted city social plus two early podcast ads that lift word of mouth to 56.5%. Late pop-ups ($2500 each on days 53–54) and the $300 café partners each earn only 0.3–0.5% of adoption, and A2's lack of podcasts leaves it at 14.9% reach and $1150 per point.

plan.headline: Podcasts, city social and a Burberry drop reach 25.8% of natural audience
plan.summary: The bet is two early host-read podcast ads, full-length targeted social across London and a Burberry co-branded drop that seed word of mouth among Chelsea and Premier League fans. Qloo taste data shows this crowd over-indexes on Burberry (0.92), Talk Is Jericho (0.91) and Monday Morning Podcast (0.90), and in the simulation word of mouth drives 57.3% of adoption. The simulation built on Qloo taste data projects about 25.8% reach of the natural audience (range 24.3%–27.2%), roughly 3.2x the 8.1% benchmark, at $760 per point of reach versus $1,891; this is a projection, not a guarantee.

weeks.label: 8–7 weeks before launch
items: 55 days before launch: start targeted social ads across London, weighted to best-fit districts; run through launch day ($10,080 total).
55 days before launch: set up sign-up pop-ups at Moca caffee and The Big Plate Cafe, Greenwich, kept for the whole campaign ($300 each).
52 days before launch: host-read ad airs on Talk Is Jericho ($3,450).
50 days before launch: Burberry co-branded drop goes live and runs 40 days ($2,000).

weeks.label: 6–5 weeks before launch
items: 43 days before launch: host-read ad airs on Monday Morning Podcast ($3,500).
43–36 days before launch: push podcast and drop content through social to fuel word of mouth.

weeks.label: 4–2 weeks before launch
items: 28–14 days before launch: keep social running; promote five-a-side sign-ups at the Greenwich cafés.
10 days before launch: Burberry drop window closes; recap it on social.

weeks.label: Launch week
items: 7–1 days before launch: final social push for match nights and tournament.
Launch day: big-screen match night and five-a-side kickoff; cafés hand out next-fixture info.

media.name: Host-read ad on Talk Is Jericho
media.why: Qloo affinity 0.91; credited 4.9% of simulated adoption.

media.name: Host-read ad on Monday Morning Podcast
media.why: Qloo affinity 0.90; weakest big spend at 4.4% of adoption.

media.name: Co-branded drop with Burberry
media.action: Co-branded drop from 50 to 10 days before launch, no club or alcohol tie.
media.why: Qloo affinity 0.92; second-highest credited action at 7.3% for $2,000.

risks: Projections come from a simulation on Qloo taste data; real reach may fall outside 24.3%–27.2%.
Burberry drop must avoid any club crest or alcohol tie to stay compliant.
Monday Morning Podcast earns least per dollar among big spends; watch its response.
Greenwich cafés contribute under 1% of adoption; expect little direct pull from them.
measure: Weekly sign-ups for match nights and five-a-side, by source code (social, each podcast, Burberry, cafés).
Social cost per sign-up by London district.
Share of sign-ups citing a friend referral, as a word-of-mouth check.
Podcast promo-code and Burberry drop link redemptions.
